runtime_note: The predicate LOGIC is fully static and exhaustively solved by z3 over the complete enum domain {posix, nt}. However os.name is a runtime attribute of the stdlib os module, set by the CPython interpreter at import time from the live platform; it is NOT reachable from CLI/YAML/public input. A caller cannot drive this branch either way without changing the host OS (or monkeypatching os.name). Hence classification=runtime-dependent: the witnesses are real z3 models but the actual taken branch is environment-determined, not solver-chosen. On the char-test CI host (posix) os.name==posix, so os.name != nt is ALWAYS True and the if-branch ALWAYS executes: writeRunScript emits the ROCm-SMI clock-pinning block (gated further by globalParameters[PinClocks] and [ROCmSMIPath]). The else path (Windows) is unreachable on posix.
